title: How long will it take to see progress in my kid’s skills after occupational therapy sessions start?
metaTitle: Seeing Progress in Your Child's Skills with Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the varying factors that influence the speed of progress in your child's skills after starting occupational therapy. Discover when you may notice improvements and how to track progress effectively.
html: The time to see progress in a child's skills can vary depending on individual factors such as the severity of symptoms, the frequency of therapy, and the child's active engagement in sessions. Generally, you could start observing small improvements in a few weeks, with more significant progress over several months.
